import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { track } from "./track";

// Introspected as a lookup: a 18-row code list: referenced by 1 table(s), references none, 3 or fewer simple columns.
export const playlist = defineTable("playlist", {
    columns: {
        playlistId: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        name: col.varchar({ length: 120 })
    },
    relations: {
        track: rel.manyToMany(() => track)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
